name: MLX-LM on 64GB Apple M4 Max: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 8-bit generation throughput (128 tokens)
methodology: mlx_lm.benchmark --model mlx-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-8bit -p 2048 -g 128. Batch size 1, 2048 prompt tokens, 128 generated tokens. Hardware: Apple M4 Max 64GB unified memory. Software: mlx 0.29.2.dev20251008+85a8824a8, mlx-lm 0.28.2, macOS 26.1. Peak memory: 33.46 GB. MMLU Pro: 72.46.
notes: Official benchmark published by Apple MLX maintainers in mlx_lm/BENCHMARKS.md. Demonstrates that 8-bit quantization on M4 Max achieves 83.16 tok/s with 33.46 GB memory footprint and MMLU Pro of 72.46 (vs 113.33 tok/s and 70.71 MMLU Pro for 4-bit).
